accepted_state: DEDAL remains one coherent persistent intelligence with the always-active Cognitive Runtime and progressively disclosed specialist faculties.
YouTube Publishing remains active; this release hardens the already-promoted dedicated MCP/Gateway workflow rather than creating a duplicate capability.
Caption list/insert/readback/VTT-download/update/delete has representative live evidence and the lifecycle test restored the original video state.
Thumbnail upload has representative end-to-end live evidence on an owned video.

Playlist image first insert and managed replacement have representative live evidence; production replacement requires a DEDAL-managed baseline, delete -> insert -> readback, managed-state persistence, and rollback on failed insertion.
Native playlistImages.update is not a production dependency because isolated live attempts produced inconsistent unexpectedPart failures around resumable processing.
Channel banner upload/apply/readback has representative live evidence; rollback must retain a recoverable full-resolution source rather than depending on a display-oriented bannerExternalUrl.
Watermark set/unset is exposed but not fully live-gated because current watermark state cannot be reliably discovered; unmanaged watermark state fails closed absent explicit Creator authority.
YouTube mutation debugging uses dedicated MCP -> bounded Gateway -> stage-aware D1 audit -> exact vendor error -> minimal patch -> one bounded retry -> readback verification -> checkpoint.
Live hardening evidence reported Gateway 0.7.35, but the public repo Gateway source still identifies itself as 0.3.0; deployed/source equivalence is not claimed until source sync.
unresolved_risks: The deployed Gateway advanced beyond the source snapshot committed in this public repository; exact source parity must be recovered before the repo can reproduce the current deployment.
The exact deployed MCP version was not independently established by this reconciliation; the checked-in source still identifies itself as 0.1.0.
Channel banner replacement has a proven full-resolution restore technique but does not yet have the same persisted managed-baseline/rollback model as playlist images.
Watermark lifecycle must remain fail-closed for unmanaged state until a managed-state model or explicit Creator authorization exists.
YouTube vendor media/upload semantics and documentation can change; current requirements and error behavior need live verification when material.
YouTube Analytics summary/search-term retrieval remains unresolved from the prior checkpoint; this hardening work did not provide new evidence that the upstream Analytics read path is working.

next_executable_step.action: Recover and compare the currently deployed YouTube Gateway/MCP source against the public repository, import only the verified missing implementation delta, then add managed baseline/rollback for banner and watermark before promoting watermark lifecycle.
